_comment: Copy this file to machines.json and adjust it. The sum of limit_gb for both Macs should stay below the real capacity of the Google drive (leave a safety margin, e.g. 10-15%, for rclone/Google overhead and accidental growth between watchdog checks).
_bwlimit_comment: Upload speed limit in Mbps (megabits/s, as internet providers quote it) - this setting is per-Mac, so each machine can have a different value in its local machines.json. 0 = no limit.
